$comment: Every BR- code on the Bridge's own screens (plan §6, owner decision D4): the screen, the control's label and what it does. The source of truth beside src/lib/admin/clubhouse/br-codes.ts (a test holds the two to each other and to every data-br under src/app/admin). docs/bridge/generated/BRIDGE_UI_MAP.md is generated from this file by node scripts/clubhouse/bridge-ui-map.mjs; never edit that file by hand.
